description: This file defines the AuthCodeRepository class implementing OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface, with methods for handling OAuth2 authorization codes, including creating, revoking, and checking revocation status.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth2 authorization codes within SuiteCRM, implementing the AuthCodeRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Method to persist a new authorization code; currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Method to revoke an authorization code; currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if an auth code is revoked; always returns true.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AuthCodeEntity instance.
